name: Solenne Atelier Mirrorline Scarf
description: A long drape scarf in deep obsidian with a woven Mirrorline thread that creates a faint reflective sheen — shifting from matte to luminous as the wearer moves. The fabric is woven with passive signal-dampening threads that block ambient BCI broadcast bleed, offering a narrow privacy buffer in crowded boardrooms. Width is generous enough to function as a shoulder wrap, and one end is weighted with a single cast-iron bead in a brushed bronze casing.
functionality: Passive BCI broadcast dampening within 30cm, Mirrorline optical shift weave, weighted drape bead.
what_it_says: You have thought carefully about what you broadcast in a room full of people who are always listening.
story_hooks: The signal-dampening effect is narrow but real — someone has been using these scarves to conduct conversations in open boardrooms that don't appear in the building's ambient audio logs.
The weighted bead on a particular scarf has been hollowed out and used as a dead drop container; the scarf itself has changed hands four times in six months.
